business_scope.primary_industry_name: Electronic Catalog Retail of Industrial Maintenance Hardware

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (signed 2006, in force 2012)
Colombia-European Union and its Member States Trade Agreement (in force 2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF regime) as amended by Ley 1121 de 2006; Ley 1762 de 2015 (anti-contraband); Decree 1068 of 2015 (regulatory compilation); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica and Circular Básica Contable; UBO registry: Ley 2155 de 2021 (social investment and tax evasion law) and Decree 830 of 2021 establishing the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB), administered by DIAN and Superintendencia de Sociedades, with applicable technical resolution No. 206 of 2021.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport and notarized UBO declaration for each non-resident ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Constitución y Vigencia) for each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or Chamber of Commerce in the shareholder’s country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution authorizing the incorporation of the Colombian SAS and appointment of legal representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shareholders’ general meeting or board of directors of the foreign shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation of all notarial and corporate documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator authorized by the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and substantial shareholders against the Colombian Lista de Personas Expuestas Políticamente (PEP), the former Lista Clinton administered by UIAF, OFAC/OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated list, and the Colombian national registry of money laundering and terrorism financing risks. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs and any person resident in or originating from a high-risk jurisdiction as defined by FATF, with verification through recognized commercial and government databases before incorporation and on a continuous basis after registration.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), processed through the territorial Chamber of Commerce having jurisdiction over the registered office, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be submitted in Spanish. A transliteration into the Latin alphabet is required for names originating from non-Latin scripts. The name must include the suffix 'S.A.S.' or 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada', and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, internationally protected mark, or official public institution name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Texto that requires prior authorization from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, Superintendencia de Economía Solidaria, or other regulatory body
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a formal rejection notice from the Chamber of Commerce, the applicant may file a written reconsideration with the same Chamber of Commerce within five business days. If the Chamber upholds the rejection, the applicant may elevate the appeal to the Superintendencia de Sociedades under the Código de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo (Ley 1437 de 2011). The appeal must specify legal arguments, include any corrected name alternatives, and request a substantive decision within the statutory administrative deadlines.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or registered-agent service address is permitted as the administrative domicile for a B2B MRO e-commerce S.A.S., provided the company maintains a physical office or other verifiable presence in Colombia for service of process and tax inspection. The registered office for statutory purposes must be a real geographic location within the municipal territory of the chosen Chamber of Commerce. Co-working and virtual office arrangements are commonly accepted for low-risk e-commerce businesses, but the address must be effectively verifiable and capable of receiving official correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate–low. Estimated annual probability of unannounced physical inspection for a low-risk, standard AML tier e-commerce SAS is approximately 10–15%, taking into account DIAN site visits, Chamber of Commerce verification checks, and Superintendencia de Sociedades inspection programs under Ley 1258 de 2008.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation fee (búsqueda de homonimia)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of the Chamber of Commerce (national fee schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of S.A.S. bylaws and incorporation documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk SAS incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille, and consular legalization of foreign corporate and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff and prevailing apostille fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translations of non-Spanish corporate records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator registered with the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for sworn translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the S.A.S. with the Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee based on registered capital and business volume

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registry registration and AML/PEP/sanctions screening compliance file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN and Superintendencia de Sociedades through professional compliance agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML/UBO compliance services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial registered office / virtual office setup fee for the first month
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified co-working or virtual office provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-cost Bogotá or Medellín virtual office

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regime), Articles 1, 5, 22 and 45; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110, 353-354; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Article 2.2.1.1 et seq.; Ley 1429 de 2010 (simplified registration)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUE), subject to oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private instrument of incorporation) filed with the Chamber of Commerce; public deed (Escritura Pública) mandatory only when in-kind contributions exceed 500 legal monthly minimum wages or the founders elect formal notarization
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital for an S.A.S. under Ley 1258 de 2008, Article 5; capital is freely determined in Colombian Pesos and may be paid in full or in installments within a statutory maximum term of two years from incorporation; foreign direct investment must be registered with Banco de la República for statistical and exchange purposes but no escrow account is required; capital payments may be made in cash or in-kind per appraisals recorded in the by-laws
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. — UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT. The shareholders, duly convened, resolve: (1) The authorized, subscribed and paid-in capital is COP _______, fully subscribed per the by-laws and payable within the statutory two-year maximum term. (2) The registered office is adopted at ________ (city, department, address), Colombia, as the legal and notificable domicile. (3) [Shareholder Name] is appointed Legal Representative and General Manager, and [Name] as Secretary/Treasurer, with full statutory powers, and both are authorised to execute incorporation filings, bank appointments, and administrative licensing documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability and Homonymy Check
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (virtual portal: Registro Único Empresarial – RUE / ventanilla virtual de trámites)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Initiate a prior name-search request in the Chamber of Commerce's online portal or physically at the registry window. Request the 'Certificado de Homologación y Similitud' to confirm that no identical or confusingly similar corporate name is already registered. The reservation of a valid name is valid for 30 calendar days and is a mandatory precondition to registration. For an S.A.S., the proposed name must end with 'S.A.S.' and be distinctive from existing trademarks and registrants.
required_dossiers: Formulario de Homologación de Nombre (name availability form)
Applicant identification (cédula or passport)
Up to three proposed corporate names in order of preference
Payment receipt of name search fee if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber flags confusion or resemblance with an existing registrant, file a 'recurso de reposición' before the same Chamber within ten business days attaching a notarized no-objection letter from the earlier entity or rebranding to a distinctly different name; a revised availability request is then submitted and processed within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Notary (Notaría) for authenticity certification; alternatively, Cámara de Comercio certification program for signature authentication in private incorporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the complete private incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución) containing all mandatory S.A.S. clauses under Ley 1258 de 2008: name, domicile, corporate purpose (ISIC 4791 – electronic retail of industrial maintenance hardware), capital structure, share classes, board and management provisions, and dissolution terms. Cause each shareholder or their legal representative to sign the document and authenticate signatures before a notary or through the Chamber's certification service. If in-kind contributions exceed 500 legal monthly minimum wages, execute the incorporation as a public deed before a notary.
required_dossiers: Finalized articles of incorporation / by-laws including all SAS mandatory clauses
Shareholders' identification documents and domicile declarations
Notarized or Chamber-certified signatures of incorporated shareholders
Special power of attorney (poder especial) for proxy subscribers, notarized
Appraisal report for in-kind contributions if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber identifies defective or incomplete clauses, execute a corrective addendum (otra sí) signed by all subscribing shareholders and re-certify before the same notary; documents are then re-submitted to the Chamber without restarting the process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant Registration with Chamber of Commerce (RUE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social – Registro Mercantil / Registro Único Empresarial (RUE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument, completed formal registration forms, and the payment of inscription fees via the Chamber's virtual assistant or at the physical registry window. Upon verification, the Chamber issues the 'Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal', which is conclusive proof of legal existence, and automatically transmits data to DIAN to generate provisional NIT. The legal representative must sign the register form and provide a valid government-issued ID. Registration confers legal personality retroactive to the date of the instrument.
required_dossiers: Executed and certified incorporation instrument (private document or public deed) with copies
Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) with activity codes ISIC 4791 / NAICS 423840
Pre-registration RUT or provisional tax information if already obtained
Certificate of payment of Chamber registration fees
Identification documents of legal representative and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a negative decree (auto de rechazo or devolución), the applicant has ten business days to file curative submissions via the virtual portal; where the defect is substantive, file a corrective 'reforma estatutaria' before the notary and re-submit; final appeals lie with the Superintendencia de Sociedades as 'recurso de apelación'.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification Registration with DIAN (NIT and RUT Activation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (RUT portal and Sede Electrónica DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the RUT registration or update of the pre-registration by filing Formulario de Registro Único Tributario after receiving the Chamber certificate. The legal representative must activate the company's digital mailbox (Sede Electrónica DIAN), obtain an electronic signature certificate, and formally update the RUT with principal activity ISIC 4791 (retail via internet) and secondary logistics/warehousing activities. The provisional NIT becomes definitive after RUT validation; all subsequent electronic invoicing and tax filings require this credential.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by Chamber of Commerce
Fully completed RUT form (Formulario 001) signed by legal representative
SAS by-laws and corporate documents for DIAN file verification
Identification of legal representative and power of attorney if filed through proxy
Declaration of economic activities and estimated annual gross income
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or queries the RUT, submit a corrective PQRSD (petición, queja, reclamo, sugerencia, denuncia) through 'Sede Electrónica DIAN' attaching the Chamber certificate; any change of domicile or activity must be updated within ten business days; late filing penalties are waived if corrected within the DIAN 'régimen de normalización tributaria' thresholds for newly constituted entities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commerce Registration and Physical Facility Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal – Secretaría de Hacienda (Industria y Comercio registry); Secretaría de Planeación; Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the e-commerce and warehouse operation in the municipal Registro de Industria y Comercio to enable lawful commercial operation and annual ICA tax (impuesto de industria y comercio) payment. Obtain the Certificado de Uso de Suelo from the planning authority for the warehouse address, and secure the Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety inspection) for storage areas. These permits are mandatory prerequisites for opening the corporate bank account and for enabling operational liability insurance. The ICA registration must be renewed annually and the fire certificate on a biannual basis.
required_dossiers: Final RUT with ICA activity indicated
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (updated)
Lease agreement or title deed for the warehouse/office address
Certificado de Uso de Suelo issued by Secretaría de Planeación
Fire safety inspection request form and fee payment receipt
Occupancy / building occupancy load certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For denial of use-of-soil, file an administrative reconsideration before the 'Comité de Uso de Suelo' of the respective municipality; for fire safety deficiencies, rectify the inspection observations and request a re-inspection within fifteen calendar days; municipal decisions are appealable through descriptive channels under the Ley 1437 de 2011 (Código de Procedimiento Administrativo).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Secretaría Distrital/Municipal de Hacienda (ICA registry for commercial activity); Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for environmental permitting; Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for consumer and industrial surveillance; policy head: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (MinCIT)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Industria y Comercio (municipal operating registry) together with Certificado de Uso de Suelo and Certificado de Bomberos for the warehouse and stocking facility; a special national operating license is not required for electronic retail of industrial MRO supplies under ISIC 4791

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for large-scale projects; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) or Autoridad Ambiental Urbana for municipal warehouse and distribution facilities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category IV – Low Impact Registration (Registro Ambiental) under Decreto 1076 de 2015; full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) not required for standard MRO e-commerce distribution unless the storage facility exceeds 5,000 m² or handles hazardous wastes above the regulatory thresholds, in which case the project is elevated to Category II requiring a Diagnóstico Ambiental de Alternativas
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Resolución 0631 de 2015 (max. pH 6.0–9.0, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L for non-domestic discharges); atmospheric emissions per Resolución 909 de 2008 and Resolución 2254 de 2017 (PM10 ≤ 100 µg/m³ annual, SO₂ ≤ 50 µg/m³ annual); volatile organic compound (VOC) controls for solvent storage per NTC 5079 and Ministry decrees; hazardous waste management per Decreto 4741 de 2005 including manifest and tracking system; MRO chemical and battery waste must be disposed through authorized environmental handlers with an annual compliance report to CAR

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) issued under Resolución 2024 de 2015 (Unified Fire Code) after inspection of extinguishing systems, emergency exits and combustible storage; structural load certification from an authorized architect/engineer for pallet racking and mezzanine shelving; occupancy load certificate and municipal habitability permit; occupational health and safety registration with an ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) and compliance inspection under Resolución 0312 de 2019 establishing the minimum workplace safety conditions for storage and catalog distribution employees

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must appoint a local legal representative or attorney-in-fact in Colombia, obtain a power of attorney (poder especial), apply for pre-registration with DIAN to obtain a provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) form declaring the entity's legal nature, principal activity (ISIC 4791), and tax regime, and then file for final registration using the DIAN electronic portal (MUISCA) or through an authorized accountant. The NIT is issued within approximately 5–10 business days once the documentation is validated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No 'check-the-box' regime exists under Colombian law. A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) is by default treated as a separate taxable entity subject to Colombian corporate income tax (retefuente, VAT, and national consumption tax as applicable). No hybrid mismatch or transparent entity elections are available for an S.A.S. Special tax stabilization contracts under Law 1955/2019 may be available only for certain investments exceeding minimum thresholds.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 (no monetary de minimis threshold). VAT registration is mandatory for any legal entity, including non-resident e-commerce operators, that routinely or occasionally makes taxable supplies of goods or services to Colombian customers. Foreign digital suppliers must register through the simplified electronic registration procedure (RUT simplificado) before the first taxable transaction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia mandates the use of electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) for all registered VAT taxpayers. Invoices must be generated in a standardized XML format, digitally signed, and transmitted in real time to DIAN for validation and fiscal clearance via web services or an authorized technology operator (Tecnólogo Autorizado). DIAN validates each invoice before it may be delivered; there is no per-invoice digital stamping, but the DIAN response code constitutes the clearance. Missing validation exposes the taxpayer to sanctions for unregistered invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports qualify for 0% VAT if physically exported out of Colombian customs territory and supported by an export declaration (Declaración de Exportación) accepted by DIAN/Customs. Services qualify for 0% VAT if rendered for the exclusive benefit of a recipient abroad and the use and exploitation occurs outside Colombia, provided the exporter is registered as an exporter (Exportador). Supplies of industrial MRO goods via electronic catalog and cross-border sales must demonstrate that title passes outside Colombia and that the goods leave the national territory.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading (BL) or Air Waybill (AWB)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas)
Commercial Invoice issued under DIAN electronic invoicing rules
Evidence of payment and FX repatriation through authorized intermediaries
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retroactively assess VAT, plus default interest, for up to 5 years if zero-rating documents are missing or false. Penalties for fraudulent export claims range from 100% to 200% of the tax evaded, with additional sanctions up to 5,000 UVTs for invoicing irregularities. Criminal prosecution under Colombian customs law (Law 1762/2015) may apply, including prison terms up to 9 years for export tax fraud, and cancellation of the taxpayer's export registration and VAT status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (BANREP) - Foreign Exchange Subdirectorate; DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) validates exchange declarations; Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia supervises authorized foreign exchange intermediaries
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed convertibility regime under Law 9 of 1991 and External Resolution 8 of 2000. Current-account transactions are convertible through authorized foreign exchange intermediaries, while capital-account inflows require registration as foreign investment in the Banco de la República electronic system. Profit remittance and capital repatriation are permissible once the foreign investment is registered and applicable domestic taxes are cleared. The target ISIC 4791 B2B MRO e-commerce scope is a standard permitted current-account activity, not subject to sector-specific foreign ownership restrictions, and present low convertibility risk provided all cross-border payments are channeled through the official FX market.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For merchandise exports, Colombian law requires that export proceeds be collected and channeled through the authorized foreign exchange market within 6 months from the date of the export customs declaration, unless an express exception or bank-supported extension is obtained. The mandatory surrender/canalization ratio is effectively 100% of the export invoice value; the exporter may either convert the foreign currency into Colombian pesos through the authorized intermediary or apply the funds to permitted foreign-currency obligations, and may retain foreign currency offshore only through a registered compensation account (cuenta de compensación). Failure to reintegrate in time can result in exchange-control fines and loss of statutory benefits.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational demand deposit account (cuenta corriente empresarial) with dedicated FX desk and foreign-investment capital contribution subledger
Operational current account with international trade desk and non-resident investor payment support
Enterprise current account with cash management and ACH/SWIFT e-banking
Transactional current account with cross-border treasury services and foreign-exchange hedging desk
Operational current account and trade finance facility for import settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Offshore digital EMI accounts (Wise, Payoneer, Revolut Business) are not licensed Colombian deposit-taking institutions, cannot legally hold COP, and are not authorized to act as foreign exchange intermediaries for Colombian statutory FX obligations. They are acceptable only as front-end payment collection rails or ancillary payout cards, but they must never replace a main corporate account with a supervised Colombian bank for export proceeds, tax payments, payroll, or dividend remittance. Use PSP/EMI channels for credit-card MRO catalog checkout, while maintaining the legal entity settlement account at an authorized Colombian bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no categorical statutory mandate for all directors to appear physically in Colombia. Superintendencia Financiera regulations permit risk-based remote onboarding using secure audiovisual interviews and verified documentation for low-risk corporate clients. In practice, at least one live interview with the appointed legal representative (or an authorized natural-person signer) is required; non-resident directors may execute notarized powers of attorney and provide apostilled corporate resolutions. For the target low-risk SAS, a fully remote video interview plus apostilled documents is generally feasible, but the final decision depends on each bank's internal KYC policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Beneficial ownership opacity in a non-resident-owned SAS with a local nominee legal representative
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled articles of incorporation and company bylaws; RUES registration certificate and DIAN NIT; complete UBO declaration identifying all natural persons with 5% or more economic ownership; passports and proof of residence of UBOs; notarized power of attorney to the Colombian legal representative; source-of-funds letter; organizational chart from ultimate shareholders to the SAS; sworn statement that no nominee shareholders are used.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse media matches on directors, UBOs, or the corporate group
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions/PEP screening results against OFAC, UN Consolidated List, EU, HMT and Colombian Superintendencia Financiera circular lists; signed negative PEP declarations from all directors and UBOs; official background check reports; independent legal counsel opinion on entities in high-risk jurisdictions; explanation of any country-risk nexus and evidence of legitimate business purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Cross-border e-commerce transaction pattern showing high velocity, anonymous buyers, or mismatch with declared activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Production MRO catalog URL and platform records; evidence of B2B merchant onboarding with customer NITs and contracts; sample purchase orders and invoices; logistics agreements with carriers; payment-acquirer statements; chargeback and dispute history; forecast of transaction volumes; AML risk assessment aligned with ISIC 4791 low-risk standard.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Unsolicited or pre-onboarding capital remittance from a foreign related party before account opening and UBO clearance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-notification letter to bank compliance; finalized corporate documents and account application reference; expected SWIFT MT103 details; source-of-funds letter from the remitter; evidence of capital call or shareholder resolution; clear denomination as 'capital contribution for foreign direct investment' and not as a loan or trade payment; proposed Banco de la República foreign investment declaration.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity capital must be received through an authorized foreign exchange intermediary. The nonresident shareholder should issue a SWIFT MT103 to the SAS's Colombian bank account, clearly referencing the beneficiary NIT and the purpose of 'inversion directa de no residentes en Colombia' (direct nonresident investment in local companies). The receiving bank will execute the statutory exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional) and may require the Santander-like purpose code category for direct investment; no generic 'remittance' label should be used. The bank verifies the remitter, source of funds, beneficiary identity, and sanctions status before final credit. The capital contribution must be registered in the Banco de la República foreign investment registry through the authorized intermediary to secure future dividend and capital repatriation rights.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For day-to-day MRO supplier payments, the primary clearing rail is an outgoing SWIFT MT103 executed by the Colombian bank after purchase of foreign currency from the authorized FX market. For larger, repetitive procurements requiring security, use irrevocable and, where prudent, confirmed documentary letters of credit governed by UCP600, advised through the Colombian bank. Each import payment must be supported by commercial invoice, packing list, transport document (B/L, AWB, CMR) and, when controlled goods are involved, any applicable import registration or prior license. The bank will raise the goods import exchange declaration and require the statutory import purpose concept code. The SAS must not pay an intermediary shell entity outside the documented commercial chain without a genuine buy-sell contract and full trade-chain documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD over-the-counter outright forward contracts with authorized Colombian foreign exchange intermediaries
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/COP when physical delivery is impractical or foreign counterparty limitations apply
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (USD-COP CCS/CCIRS) executed with supervised Colombian banks
FX options (currency calls/puts) offered by authorized foreign exchange intermediaries for hedging MRO inventory procurement costs
Colombian exchange-traded USD/COP futures and standardized forward contracts available through supervised exchange participants

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) where the company holds its commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a progressive late-fee surcharge and monetary fines; continued non-renewal may lead to administrative cancellation of the commercial registry and loss of active legal standing for commercial operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Deposit of Financial Statements (Depósito de Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) with which the company is registered
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the shareholders' meeting; the meeting must occur by March 31 following the calendar year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit financial statements exposes the company to fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and restricts the legal validity of profit distributions and corporate acts relying on unapproved financial statements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the date assigned in the annual DIAN tax calendar, generally between March and April according to the last two digits of the company's NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely filing produces a monthly late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax unpaid, with a minimum of 10 UVT, plus compensatory interest; inaccurate filing can trigger additional fines and tax statement corrections.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the date published in the DIAN resolution, commonly before May 31 for the immediately preceding taxable year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or late submission incurs periodic fines per month of delay up to statutory caps and may prevent the company from obtaining tax settlement certifications or reducing unpaid tax withholdings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Update (Reporte y Actualización de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Registro de Beneficiarios Finales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual update required by DIAN; generally to be filed by the end of September of each calendar year or on the date expressly set in the applicable DIAN resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late, incomplete, or inaccurate reporting may result in monetary fines of up to 20,000 UVT and adverse compliance effects on tax registration and foreign remittance procedures.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A licensed Revisor Fiscal and independent statutory audit are mandatory when, in the preceding fiscal year-end, total gross revenue or total assets exceed 30,000 UVT; when by legal or regulatory nature the company is under surveillance by the Superintendencia de Sociedades; when securities are offered publicly; or when the company otherwise qualifies as a public-interest entity. SAS companies below the thresholds may be exempt from statutory audit, subject to a certified accountant's review.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombia adopts IFRS; entities qualifying as small or medium-sized must apply NIIF para Pymes, while large entities apply full IFRS as established by Decree 2420 of 2015 and subsequent amendments. Financial statements are presented in Colombian pesos (COP) and must comply with the technical accounting framework applicable to the company's size and activity.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually the legal representative must verify, before the DIAN-filing deadline, the identity and direct and indirect participation of all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), including any shareholding transfers occurring during the prior year. Each transfer of shares must be documented in the Register of Members and reflected in an updated UBO confirmation filed with DIAN; inaccuracies or omissions are subject to fines and administrative consequences.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Acciones)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Junta Directiva or equivalent)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No structural tax holiday for general MRO catalog retailers. Targeted reliefs include the 'naranja' 7-year renta exenta for qualifying creative/cultural industries (registration with Mincultura required), a 25% super-deduction on investments in science, technology and innovation, and the depreciation deduction under E.T. Art. 158. In practice, an S.A.S. fully taxed at 35% with allowable deductions obtains an effective rate close to the headline rate.
